DRFT-85: Build.bound/claim_url were marked deprecated in DRFT-84 (shipped
v0.9.0, 2026-08-21) and are removed here now that the N-2 compatibility
window has closed — three releases (v0.9.1, v0.10.0, v0.11.0) have shipped
since, and the CLI's first-ever public npm release (v0.1.0) postdates the
deprecation, so no installed client anywhere could depend on these fields.
Server-side, both were already dead/hardcoded since DRFT-80. See DRFT-85 for
the full compatibility analysis.

POST /v1/builds removed the required property `data/bound` from the response with the `200` status
POST /v1/builds removed the required property `data/bound` from the response with the `201` status
